# Quality tables (generated by tools/quality_tables.py)

Source: `results.json` from run_quality.py (run_quality.py v1, 2026-11-13T06:47:10Z). Reference: Blender Cycles 5.3.0 CPU, 256 spp, add-on 603ca7a. Metric: FLIP LDR, flip-evaluator 1.7.

## Seed-to-seed spread of the reference

Cycles seed 0 against seed 1, FLIP: mean 0.0034, max 0.0107 over 15 scenes. Reseeding the reference moves any leg's F by far less than this (a skeptic re-scored every leg against seed 1 and a 512 spp average: changes of at most 0.00014 per leg and the leg order did not change in any scene), so it is the spread of the reference image itself, not the error bar of a leg-against-leg comparison.

## F split by the reference footprint
